description: Searches available cars and final prices for given dates and Tenerife offices. Returns only Canarias.com's own fleet. The enlaceBusquedaWeb field contains the complete website price list. The modoEnlace field identifies the configured continuation mode. The price includes full insurance with no excess (drivers aged 23 or over, subject to terms). Each offer also shows the deposit. Each result includes precioOnline (advance online payment, 10% online payment discount; null when only pay at pickup is available), precioEnOficina (standard rate, paid at pickup), ahorroOnline (precioEnOficina minus precioOnline, computed by the engine) and, when available, resumenPrecio (ready-made text with both prices). Online payment is optional; prepaid rentals can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before pickup, with a refund. The deposit guarantees the car is returned on time.
